changelog: New Order now has an Order Date box, so old orders can be entered on the date they actually came in. Job due dates are worked out from that date too, not from today.
Job No can be typed by hand when taking an order — useful for matching a GST bill — or left blank to be generated automatically as before.
Job No and Order Date can both be changed later from Edit Order, at any time. A job number already used by another order is refused, and every change is recorded in the activity log.
